concepts.definition: a whole number that may be positive, negative, or zero
a number that represents one part or several equal parts of a whole
a ratio or fraction expressed as a number out of one hundred
a comparison of two quantities by division
an equation whose highest power of the unknown is one
the figure formed by two rays meeting at a common endpoint
a polygon with three sides and three interior angles
the sum of a set of values divided by the number of values
the middle value when a data set is arranged in order
a measure of how likely an event is to occur
